behavior_constraints: benchmark command runs inference N times (default 10) on input file and reports total time, avg per run, avg per row, and rows/sec throughput
benchmark output format: 'Benchmark: <model> (<N> runs, <rows> rows per run)' followed by timing lines
benchmark with nonexistent model exits 1 with 'not found'
benchmark with nonexistent input file exits 1 with 'file not found'
prune command sets weight-matrix values below threshold absolute value to 0.0
prune does not count or modify bias values
prune reports total weights, pruned count with percentage, and new sparsity percentage
prune output format: 'Pruning \'<model>\' (threshold=<value>)' followed by stats lines
prune with --dry-run only reports without modifying weights file and appends '(dry run - no changes made)'
prune without --dry-run overwrites weights.bin with pruned weights
affected_prior: checkpoints.go (cmdCheckpoint used by prune for pre-prune checkpoint)
entities.summary: This round adds a benchmark command for measuring inference timing performance and a prune command for setting near-zero weights to zero with optional dry-run and automatic checkpoint creation.

instruction_head:
Add model performance benchmarking and weight pruning capabilities.

**Requirements:**

1. **`mlpipe benchmark <model> --input <file> [--runs <N>]`**: Measure inference performance.
   - Run inference N times (default: 10) on the input file
   - Report timing statistics:
     - Total time
     - Average time per run
     - Average time per row
     - Rows per second (throughput)
   - Output format:
     ```
     Benchmark: <model> (<N> runs, <rows> rows per run)
     Total time:    <X>ms
